title: Resurrection From the Cosmos of Death
description: The contest between awakening and the negative cosmogony. T13 sets out the Five Awakeners — the Lord's drawers-upward by whom the dead are raised in five distinct operations, also called Loosing, Stillness, Fast, Day, Rest, Peace: one ascent under many names. T14 traces the negative cosmogony against which the awakeners stand — the cosmos of death built up from the self's pourings, with its five worlds of flesh, the twelve spirits of error, the great contest with the Divine Human. The two together: what raises and what was raised from.
